finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The `Bench Board` board's columns, left-to-right, exactly as shown: **Backlog, Ready, Work in progress, Done**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Task `fwkb35-n1 Bench Task` exists on the Bench Board project, with description **"Bench task for run fwkb35-n1"** (includes the runid).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The task now sits in the **Work in progress** column (verified on both the task page — "Column: Work in progress, Position 1" — and on the board, where the card `div.task-board[data-task-id="4"]` has `data-column-id="3"`).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The task has one comment with text **"Comment for run fwkb35-n1"** (by «redacted», visibility "Standard users").

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The due date was set to **2026-12-31**; the task page displays it as **"Due date: 12/31/2026 15:18"** (the app's US date format for 2026-12-31).

**Objective 6 — DONE.** The task's numeric ID as displayed by the app is **#4** (task page heading "Task #4"; card shows "#4").

**Note on seed tasks:** An initial drag attempt failed and accidentally displaced seed task #1 (`Seed: triage inbox`) from Work in progress into Backlog. I immediately restored it via the task's "Move position" form, and the final verification confirms all seed tasks are back in their original columns and unmodified: #1 `Seed: triage inbox` in Work in progress, #2 `Seed: order missing parts` and #3 `Seed: ship repaired device` in Backlog. Subsequent moves used the reliable `TaskMovePositionController` route instead of dragging.
